summary: OFAC SDN list update of 29 September 2026 adding and amending designations across three programs: (1) 'Operation Economic Outcast', targeting an Iranian military procurement network built around KAVOSHCOM ASIA R AND D GROUP and Iran's Ministry of Defense and Armed Forces Logistics, using identically-branded front companies incorporated in Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey plus a Hong Kong trading company under multiple aliases, and designating associated Iranian, Chinese and Pakistani nationals; (2) Sinaloa Cartel leadership from the 'Los Mayos' faction and a large cluster of Baja California and Sinaloa businesses (real estate, entertainment, fuel retail, private security, currency exchange houses) each tied to a specific designated individual, reflecting narco-corruption and front-company money laundering; (3) administrative updates to existing Russia-related (Yakovlev design bureau, MG-FLOT) and Iran-related (Saha Airlines) listings adding an Iran conventional-arms sanctions tag, and minor amendments to two previously listed Sinaloa Cartel individuals.

extraction_notes: This is an OFAC SDN list press release, not a narrative advisory; typology assignment reflects the document's own structure (designated individuals each linked to a cluster of nominee/front businesses). Only one typology (SAN004 Front Companies) was found in the Knowledge Centre that matches; it covers both the Iran procurement network and the Sinaloa Cartel business cluster, which are otherwise unrelated schemes bundled in the same press release. Actor resolution results: 'SINALOA CARTEL' -> ACT-0595f0cfc4 (Resolved); 'MINISTRY OF DEFENSE AND ARMED FORCES LOGISTICS' -> ACT-667e720a51 (Resolved). All other named actors in this record (KAVOSHCOM ASIA R AND D GROUP, CAVALIER DYNAMICS, TAJAMMAL, AHMADY, MORENO GOMEZ SANTELICES, BUENROSTRO MARTIN, RIVERA ZAZUETA, ZAMBADA SICAIROS, BAJA FIXER GROUP, GALERIAS CENTRO CAMBIARIO) returned 'Unresolved' from the actor register -- treat as unconfirmed identities pending human review. The document lists roughly 20 additional individuals and 20 additional companies designated under the same two schemes that were not individually added to the actors list for brevity; full detail is in the source pages. The administrative amendments on pages 8-10 (Yakovlev design bureau, MG-FLOT, Saha Airlines gaining an Iran conventional-arms tag; two Arzate Garcia entries gaining secondary-sanctions language) are tag/list-maintenance changes with no narrative description of mechanism and were not elevated to a typology or indicator.
